gitCommit.subject: cleanup: finalized-result item-immutability (526), keyed triage reset (h75), gh-pages deploy fix (#199) (#209)
gitCommit.body:
cleanup: finalized-result item-immutability (526), keyed triage reset (h75), gh-pages deploy fix (#199) (#209)

* fix(sort): reject item mutations on a finalized result with 409 (purses-526)

Finalized sort-results are immutable (infra spec §11.3), but the three
item-mutation routes (PATCH/DELETE on [rid], POST on [rid]/reset) let you
mutate or delete an item on a FINALIZED result. Add a guard after the
requireApiResultAccess gate: when the resolved parent result's status is
"finalized", return 409 and do not mutate.

Un-mocked proof: a new describeDb test drives the real DELETE route against
a finalized result and asserts 409 + the item still exists. Route unit tests
cover all three handlers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(sort): key DecisionControls by item.id for structural next-item reset (purses-h75)

The triage stuck-button bug (a lingering pendingLabel keeps every tier
disabled across router.refresh(), blocking the next item) was previously
fixed by resetting pendingLabel on success — timing-dependent. Make it
structural: key the <DecisionControls> element to the current triage item's
id so each item gets a fresh control instance (fresh pendingLabel=null) on
remount. The on-success setPendingLabel(null) is retained as belt-and-
suspenders (the error path still needs its own reset for the same item).

Covered by the existing 2-item triage journey in e2e/sort-session.spec.ts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(vercel): drop non-functional gh-pages deploymentEnabled; document Ignored Build Step (#199)

vercel.json's git.deploymentEnabled.gh-pages=false did nothing: Vercel reads
vercel.json from the branch being deployed, and the gh-pages reports branch
has no vercel.json, so the exclusion never applied and gh-pages still deployed
and errored. Remove the dead "git" block.

Document the real fix in docs/DEPLOYMENT.md (doc-ownership maps vercel.json ::
docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): skip gh-pages via the Vercel dashboard Ignored Build Step
(Settings -> Git) with a command that exits 0 (skip) only when
VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF is gh-pages, because that is configured on the project
rather than read from the deployed branch.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(api): item mutations on a finalized result return 409 (purses-526)

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
